Message:
I passed through a door
that Myrlennia had opened,
and made my way to “Paradise.”

That said, it’s a world that
had already met its end—
pruned and fallen from
the Tree of Life.
I’ll make good use of it, at least.

“Look at yourself.
You can no longer
be called ‘human’.”

Oh my, to think a mere spirit
would still have their
consciousness intact.
I expected nothing less from
【The Witch of Miracles】.

However, it appears
all that is left of yours is...
less than half.”

I only scraped away
the parts of me that
would hold me back
from saving him.

“So, you scraped away
your human heart...
to forsake your humanity...?
For you to do something
so reckless...”

They were holding me back,
so it’s not like I had
any other choice.
More importantly,
can you quiet yourself
for a moment?

Your power allowed me to
finally find a body for him,

so it would be a pity if
I didn’t hurry and put him inside.

Now then, Great Hero—
here is your new body.
